input.query:
SELECT
    Id,
    Contact__c,
    CreatedById,
    CreatedDate,
    Group__c,
    LastModifiedById,
    LastModifiedDate
FROM
    Group_Member__c
WHERE
    Group__r.AccountId__r.hasGroupACLs__c = true
    #{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"workato_variable","line":"0cc438c1","path":["modified_timestamp_boundary_soql"]}')}

query.sql_select_query:
WITH ranked_source AS (
    SELECT 
        Id,
        Contact__c,
        CreatedById,
        CreatedDate,
        Group__c,
        LastModifiedById,
        LastModifiedDate,
        
        -- Assign a rank of 1 to the newest record for each Contact+Group combo
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Contact__c, Group__c 
            ORDER BY LastModifiedDate DESC
        ) AS row_num
        
    FROM 
        source
)

SELECT 
    Id,
    Contact__c,
    CreatedById,
    CreatedDate,
    Group__c,
    LastModifiedById,
    LastModifiedDate
FROM 
    ranked_source
WHERE 
    row_num = 1
